items.name: Evacuation Protocols
items.desc: We must establish a new home and prepare to evacuate our homeworld.

items.name: Fortify the Border
items.desc: Defense of our systems is paramount. This Edict will direct additional resources to these ends.

items.name: Nutritional Plenitude
items.desc: It is the fundamental right of each of our citizens to enter hibernation with a full digestive organ. Easy access to plentiful, nutritional fare will be the fuel that spurs our growth among the stars.

items.name: Nutritional Plenitude
items.desc: It is the fundamental right of each of our citizens to enter hibernation with a full digestive organ. Easy access to plentiful, nutritional fare will be the fuel that spurs our growth among the stars.

items.name: Expanded Breeding Program
items.desc: Using gamification and point-based reward schemes, we will subtly encourage our Bio-Trophies to fill our Organic Sanctuaries.

items.name: Fleet Supremacy
items.desc: Our navy is our best means to project power. This Edict will prioritize them above lesser needs.

items.name: Diplomatic Grants
items.desc: This Edict initiates a diplomatic offensive in a concerted effort to improve the image of our empire.

items.name: Enhanced Surveillance
items.desc: Terrible threats probe our defenses, waiting for us to lower our guard. Increased resources must be sent to internal covert security departments to protect ourselves.

items.name: Bureau of Espionage
items.desc: Expanding our intelligence operations and prioritizing decryption technologies is critical for the well-being of the empire.

items.name: Observation Instinct
items.desc: Additional resources will be directed to nurturing and expanding our observation capabilities.

items.name: Covert Analysis Algorithm
items.desc: A substantial portion of processing power will be diverted to investigative analysis.

items.name: Tracking Implants
items.desc: Mandatory subdermal implants record movement and actions, greatly enhancing our empire's internal security. Loyal citizens have nothing to hide from the government.

items.name: Thought Enforcement
items.desc: Telepaths monitoring the citizenry for incorrect thoughts will make corrections as they find them.

items.name: Thought Pre-Emption
items.desc: Telepath drones monitor our collective mind for deviant impulses, correcting aberrations before they emerge as conscious thought.

items.name: Extended Shifts
items.desc: We must ask our workers to toil harder. A few broken bodies do not weigh much against the Greater Good.

items.name: Synaptic Reinforcement
items.desc: By increasing the synaptic links of our maintenance drones, their ability to provide for nearby drones is improved.

items.name: Industrial Maintenance
items.desc: Industrial maintenance drones are empowered to act as caretakers for the areas surrounding each district.

items.name: Drone Overdrive
items.desc: Our drones will be worked harder, as more resources are required.

items.name: Symbiont Overdrive
items.desc: Our biomes will be made more competitive, as more resources are required.

items.name: Capacity Subsidies
items.desc: This Edict allows short-term overloading of energy grids, letting power plants across our empire run at increased capacity.

items.name: Capacity Subsidies
items.desc: This Edict encourages our photosynthetic symbionts to form migratory herds that follow the sun across our surface, increasing energy output.

items.name: Mining Subsidies
items.desc: This Edict is a focused administrative effort to reprioritize and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.

items.name: Mining Subsidies
items.desc: This Edict reinforces our roots, allowing our burrowing symbionts to dig with less risk of structural collapse.

items.name: Mining Subsidies
items.desc: This Edict is a focused administrative effort to reprioritize and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.

items.name: Farming Subsidies
items.desc: This Edict provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.

items.name: Farming Subsidies
items.desc: This Edict provides aggressive dilution of high energy chemicals in our soil to boost our nutrition output.

items.name: Industrial Subsidies
items.desc: Success can be measured by the acquisition of things. This Edict provides our factories with additional resources so production can be increased.

items.name: Forge Subsidies
items.desc: Our empire thirsts for more specialized alloys and precious metals. This Edict provides our foundries with additional resources so production can be increased.

items.name: Forge Subsidies
items.desc: Saturating our lithotrophic algae pools with nutrients allows for seasonal blooms and increased harvest of alloy byproducts.

items.name: Research Subsidies
items.desc: Knowledge is power. This Edict focuses our efforts on advancing technology.

items.name: Research Subsidies
items.desc: Knowledge is power. This Edict focuses our efforts on advancing technology.

items.name: Veneration of Saints
items.desc: Rather than focusing exclusively on this temporal world, we should provide our spiritual guides with whatever they need to prepare us for the next.

items.name: Peace Festivals
items.desc: This Pacifist Edict fosters a spirit of unity and good cheer through whole seasons filled with special events and festivals.

items.name: Information Quarantine
items.desc: This Edict puts strict checks on the flow of information, better preserving local cultural identities.

items.name: Encourage Political Thought
items.desc: This Edict encourages the populace to openly discuss political matters, even if the path taken may lead them astray.

items.name: Map the Stars
items.desc: This Edict pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.

items.name: Land of Opportunity
items.desc: This Edict creates targeted PR campaigns that frame our empire as being on the cutting edge, a new social frontier - a place where anyone can thrive, a fresh start.

items.desc: The Relay Network can be directed to serve our colonies.

items.name: Zro Additives
items.desc: The properties of Zro are mysterious. Yet if given to our leaders, it seems they obtain slight precognitive abilities, allowing them to learn faster and avoid dangers that could have ended their lives early.

items.name: Zro Additives
items.desc: The properties of Zro are mysterious. Yet if sprinkled on our leader's motherboards, it seems to grant them slight precognitive abilities, allowing them to learn faster and avoid dangers that could have ended their existence.

items.name: Damn the Consequences
items.desc: This Edict pushes our genetic modifications to the very limit, doubling their effect but also causing an increased amount of terrible side-effects, including sudden catastrophic combustion.\n\n§RDamn the Consequences ignores ['concept_edict_fund'] and will always use 80% of your monthly £unity£ Unity income!§!

items.name: Shadow Matrix
items.desc: The electronic obscurity provided by dark matter processing units generates software that even the best codebreakers must struggle with.

items.name: Obsidian Veil
items.desc: To hide in a forest, one should wear the earth. To hide in space, one should wear the void.

items.name: Dark Matter Forging
items.desc: The unique binding properties of dark matter as a flux in our foundries increases the yield by appreciable amounts.

items.name: Dark Matter Unravelling
items.desc: The energy contained within bonds formed by dark matter can be unraveled into a valuable output.

items.name: Baryonic Insight
items.desc: For a deeper understanding of the weave of the universe, we must look beyond the notion of the atom.

items.name: Spontaneous Crystallization
items.desc: By applying a unique matrix of catalysts onto freshly harvested rock, we have a chance at generating much more valuable crystalline structures.

items.name: Inner Focus
items.desc: Overextension of one's boundaries introduces a variety of risks. Understanding oneself is a more reliable and productive endeavor.

items.name: Astral Cloaking
items.desc: Astral threads used in cloaking field generators partially 'reflect' our ships into other dimensions, making them even more difficult to detect in this one.

items.name: Astral Binding
items.desc: We have learned how to weave Astral Thread into any other material in the universe. It is the very fabric of dimension.

items.name: Astral Shielding
items.desc: There is no stronger barrier than a tightly knit lattice of Astral Threads.

items.name: Dimensional Artificing
items.desc: Manifesting objects of cultural significance from other dimensions can be done under the right circumstances. Whether or not our actions will be noticed in the other planes, we cannot say.

items.name: Decentralized Research
items.desc: The greatest knowledge lies external to our own civilization. By focusing on the greater whole of the galaxy, we can come to a more complete understanding of ourselves.

items.desc: Increases the efficiency of our storm attraction tech.

items.name: Storm Repulsion Field
items.desc: Increases the efficiency of our storm repulsion tech.

items.name: Hunker Down Protocols
items.desc: Any colony affected by a §YCosmic Storm§! will initiate the §YHunker Down§! Colony Decision until the danger has passed.

items.name: Centrifugal Siphoning
items.desc: Powerful centrifuges help partition liquid alloys such that they can be recomposed into £sr_living_metal£ §YLiving Metal§!.

items.name: Modular Growth Compounds
items.desc: Molecular use of £sr_living_metal£ §YLiving Metal§! allows for effective modular compounds that promote stronger growth.

items.name: Entropy Harnessing
items.desc: Integrating Crystallized Entropy production into our infrastructure allows us to fully harness our technical prowess, and exploit this volatile new resource to its fullest potential.

items.name: Fear Campaign
items.desc: The vile and beastly nature of the xeno must be communicated to our people. They must accept the truth that we stand alone in a sea of alien filth.

items.name: Education Campaign
items.desc: Back to school! By momentarily spending resources to promote higher education programs among our leaders, their skills will improve at a faster rate.

items.name: Recycling Campaign
items.desc: The populace must be taught to limit wasteful consumption of resources. A public awareness campaign to promote recycling will momentarily lower our consumer goods costs.

items.name: Healthcare Campaign
items.desc: Diet, regular exercise and sleeping patterns all combine to affect the health of our population. By promoting a healthier lifestyle, their life expectancy will go up.

items.name: Drone Campaign
items.desc: By allocating additional resources to our production facilities, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.

items.name: Machine Learning Campaign
items.desc: By allocating additional resources to our autonomous drones, they are able to increase the rate at which their self-learning algorithms improve their overall productivity.

items.name: Drone Campaign
items.desc: By allocating additional biomass to our spawning pools, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.

items.name: Learning Campaign
items.desc: By providing our autonomous drones with additional nutrients, we are able to increase their productivity.

items.name: Terraforming Gases
items.desc: By employing exotic gases in the terraforming process, we are able to achieve progress at a much faster rate.

items.name: Exotic Gases as Fuel
items.desc: Various exotic gases also function as excellent fuel for sublight travel, although perhaps not the most economical alternative.

items.name: Exotic Gases for Shield Boost
items.desc: Some exotic gases can be utilized for boosting ships' shield capabilities. They can create complex dampening fields to repel and soften enemy attacks.

items.name: Volatile Land Clearance
items.desc: By using volatile motes for their explosive capabilities, we are able to clear difficult terrain at a much faster rate.

items.name: Volatile Land Clearance
items.desc: Supplementing symbiont diets with volatile motes allows for digestion of both organic and inorganic substances. Our holobiont will adapt our own environment by eating it.

items.name: Volatile Compartment Reclamation
items.desc: By using volatile motes for their explosive capabilities, we are able to clear obstructions in bulk.

items.name: Volatile Ammunition
items.desc: We are able to deploy volatile motes as an explosive in our ships' ammunition.

items.name: Volatile Explosives
items.desc: By using volatile motes to construct specialized missiles, our ships will have greater destructive capabilities.

items.name: Volatile Reactive Armor
items.desc: By enhancing our ships' armor with a reactive component, our ships are able to absorb more damage by reducing incoming damage with a controlled counter-explosion.

items.name: Crystalline Sensors
items.desc: By employing rare crystals to boost our sensors, we are able to gain a crystal clear picture of our surroundings.

items.name: Focusing Crystals
items.desc: By increasing our ships' access to rare crystals, we are able to increase the damage of their energy weapons.

items.name: Sight Beyond Sight
items.desc: Microdosing Zro allows our navigators to sense objects beyond the reach of our scanners.

items.name: Zro Catalysis
items.desc: Among the many mysterious properties of Zro is the ability to significantly increase the capabilities of psionic beings imbibing it.

items.name: Zro Catalysis
items.desc: Our researchers have found ways to synthesize Zro to produce performance-enhancing substances that cause no negative side effects on those imbibing them.

items.name: Living Metal Mega-Construction
items.desc: The inherent properties of living metal makes it perfect for improving megastructure construction.

items.name: Nanite Actuators
items.desc: Simple but powerful nanoactuators, allowing for complex manipulations and experiments at mesoscopic scales.

items.name: Shroud Observation
items.desc: Zro is a difficult material to work with. Maintaining a small surplus can be beneficial.

items.name: Shroud-Bonded
items.desc: Bonded by our connections enabled by the Shroud, we are closer than ever before.

items.name: Master's Teachings: The Greater Good
items.desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. We could make great strides in infrastructure by following her advice on how to unify the people via self-sacrifice.

"A strong nation is built upon the sacrifice of comfort, as long as everyone is asked to carry the burden together." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

items.name: Master's Teachings: Diplomatic Trust
items.desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her anecdotes from diplomatic negotiations may act as a good basis for diplomatic negotiations.

"Encountering the children of the cosmos might feel harrowing, but ultimately it is an opportunity for hope. Be host to your neighbor and relish in their existence, as the blessing they bring is an end to the isolation of the void." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

items.name: Master's Teachings: Philosophical Mindset
items.desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. It contains several analyses and ponderings on the meaning of life and the purpose of the cosmos. By having our rulers follow this advice, we can make more informed decisions.

"The answer to the purpose of the cosmos lies outside of us, but that does not make us less inclined to find it. We must strive for unity in order to reach the answer at the root of all things." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

items.name: Master's Teachings: Warring States
items.desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her depictions of war and ideas on combat strategy could make excellent training material for our military.

"Creating unity is the biggest challenge, particularly because sustainability often generates borders. These borders need to be torn down - a sentiment which scares many. One must sometimes be willing to tear down in order to build something stronger from the ashes." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales

items.name: Improved Working Environment
items.desc: Spending time and resources to improve the working conditions of our people will surely result in better results and happier workers.\n\n

items.name: Improved Energy Initiative
items.desc: We can further limit the use of toxic fuels and non-renewable resources in order to promote research into new methods of energy production. This could help us come closer to a perfect energy cycle and improve the environment for our people to enjoy.\n\n

items.name: Extensive Sensor Searches
items.desc: After having researched advanced sensor technology we have enough information to pour extra resources into enhancing our own search scans. Our technicians would have an easier time finding objects of interest at the edge of our systems with this initiative.\n\n

items.name: Numistic Visualization
items.desc: The active use of Numistic visualization techniques will refocus our people's attention from personal gain to cosmic energy production. To achieve something, you must first visualize it.

items.name: Automated Disinfection
items.desc: The cleaning drones we discovered in one of our visits beyond an Astral Rift have enlightened us on more efficient methods of sanitation involving fleets of autonomous robots.\n

items.name: Decree: Scientific Revolution
items.desc: A brief yet highly productive golden age of scientific discovery. The combination of fearlessness, ingenuity and unbridled optimism can take you far.

items.name: Decree: Scientific Revolution
items.desc: A brief yet highly productive golden age of scientific discovery. The combination of fearlessness, ingenuity and unbridled optimism can take you far.

items.name: Decree: Desperate Measures
items.desc: The cornered animal is indeed the most dangerous, as our enemies will soon find out. No effort must be spared to ensure our continued survival.

items.name: Decree: Fortress Proclamation
items.desc: Our frontiers shall be an unassailable line, and they will convey a clear message to our most ambitious neighbors - this far, no further!

items.name: Decree: Architectural Renaissance
items.desc: It is construction on a scale that previous generations could only dream of. Megastructures may well become the true legacy of our civilization.

items.name: Decree: Nomadic Renaissance
items.desc: The nomadic way of life is now being realized on a scale once thought unattainable. The expansion of our ark fleet and the construction of new waystations shall cease to be exceptional; they must become routine.

items.name: Decree: Hearts and Minds
items.desc: A concentrated propaganda effort to make the populace understand the merits of the government's position. Ultimately, it is for their own good.

items.name: Decree: Omnifarious Acquisition
items.desc: Everything that can be spared will be recycled and used. Our ambitions require all the resources we can possibly find.

items.name: Decree: Omnifarious Acquisition
items.desc: Everything that can be spared will be recycled and used. Our ambitions require all the resources we can possibly find.

items.name: Decree: A Grand Fleet
items.desc: Our galactic ambitions require that the construction of A Grand Fleet must be our primary goal.

items.name: Decree: Will to Power
items.desc: As power is simply the ability to impose one's will on others, the will to power is a self-fulfilling prophecy.

items.name: Sacrifices
items.desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate, keen to give their lives for the better of our society. With the §HTogetherness§!, §HHarmony§! and §HBounty§! Sacrifices, they need wait no longer.

items.name: Sacrifice: Togetherness
items.desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate, ensuring that our society is brought closer together. Let our unity shine out into the lonely dark of space!

items.name: Sacrifice: Harmony
items.desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate. Their final sacrifice is a time for joyous celebration of purpose. Let every day be spent in honor of a good life!

items.name: Sacrifice: Bounty
items.desc: The most devout among us are prepared to meet their fate, keen that our society should be enriched by their final sacrifice. Let death cleanse the way for vibrant life, glorious in its essence!

items.name: Sacrifice: Bounty
items.desc: The most devout among us are prepared to meet their fate, keen that our society should be enriched by their final sacrifice. Our deaths shall bring prosperous enterprise value, and our bodies will continue serving the corporation.

items.name: Sacrifice: Dutiful
items.desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate, keen that their final sacrifice should enrich our doctrinal resolve. May their memory strengthen the conviction of our ideals!

items.name: Sacrifice: Dutiful
items.desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate, keen that their final sacrifice should enrich our doctrinal resolve. May their memory strengthen the conviction of our ideals!

items.name: Sacrifice: Dutiful
items.desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate, keen that their final sacrifice should enrich our doctrinal resolve. May their memory strengthen the conviction of our ideals!

items.name: Legislative Chorus
items.desc: The cacophony of the individualized voting streams is divided into manageable data chunks, significantly improving response speed.

items.name: Self-Preservation Override
items.desc: By remotely disabling the threat response mechanisms of the brain, enhanced citizens accept riskier work assignments.

items.name: Battle Royale
items.desc: Activate a gamified quota interface to entice specialists and workers to compete for promotions and performance badges. The nature of the endless grind partially offsets the increase in productivity.

items.name: Stately Acclaim
items.desc: The oligarchy highlights the incredible efforts of the currently exploited faction, increasing their approval and attraction. This fleeting fame can also lead to increased social mobility.

items.name: Self-Indictment Protocol
items.desc: Enables a hidden personal implant feature which uses heuristic live feed analysis to detect and report crimes without requiring the owner's consent.

items.name: Love Letter Virus
items.desc: Triggers implants to produce more pheromones and other chemicals in order to coax more "amorous" behavior towards other people in different parts of the empire.

items.name: Levied Experience
items.desc: By extracting our population's knowledge using cybernetics, we can improve our leader's experience without wasting their time with menial tasks.

items.name: Neurocasted Spectacles
items.desc: By neurocasting the brutal sport spectacles of the capital's Cyberdome directly to the cyberbrain, people flock to the capital. With their bodies safe in pods, spectators share the gladiators' experiences in first-person. A year of games!

items.name: Customer Insights
items.desc: Extensively networked surveys and real-time data analysis enable us to gauge and react to market shifts faster than ever before. Resources are diverted to features and products with the highest profit potential.

items.name: Rolling Updates
items.desc: Automated and user-independent deployment of implant updates removes the need for monolithic infrastructure. This also keeps us one step ahead of hostile cyber-incursions.

items.name: Subsidized Identity Backups
items.desc: The government provides the immense amount of server space required for continuous identity backups.

items.name: Optimized Identity Creation
items.desc: Advanced personality algorithms and core memory compression techniques improve our identity generation velocity.

items.name: Hive Mind Outreach
items.desc: The will of a determined mind moves faster than the speed of light.

items.name: Hyper-Stimulants
items.desc: Cybernetic implants automatically administer boosting drugs to our drones, increasing performance.

items.name: Integrated Mega-Construction
items.desc: This Edict allocates additional resources to our Mega-Engineering program, speeding up the construction of new galactic structures.

items.name: Aggregated Memory
items.desc: The memories of our assimilated population cascade like a rushing torrent. Their collective experience is ours to wield.

items.name: Choral Harmony
items.desc: To compose a song, there must be harmony; let the minds of our assimilated population be unified.

items.name: A Virtuous Hammering
items.desc: For a divine society, we must fully back the Fellowship of the Hammer, whose work is key to building a future that merits the divine.

items.name: The Crusade of Steel
items.desc: To guard against fiends attacking our divine flesh, we must fully support the Templars of Steel, ensuring our warriors are always prepared.

items.name: The Song of Knowledge
items.desc: Only through a vibrant song of knowledge shall our people ever truly know the divine. We must support our wise Choir of the Mind in all their endeavors.

items.name: The Labored Masses
items.desc: Our true strength lies in our laborers. If we do not have the strength to lift them up, then they will not have the strength to carry us to the future.

items.name: The Lessons of Harmony
items.desc: Unifying the Church brought many lessons. It's made our faith stronger and more contemplative than ever.

items.name: Nano-operated Supply Chains
items.desc: The flexibility of nanite based supplies that can morph into standardized ammunition or ship components will extend our supply reach to the confines of the galaxy.

items.name: Coordinated Nanocomplexes
items.desc: Infusing alloy lattices with nanites enables faster, better, and more precise alloy production along new baseline regenerative metallic properties.

items.name: Nanoconnected Generators
items.desc: Nanite maintained connectors and power lines can be restored in real time without interruption.

items.name: Space Fauna Exhibition
items.desc: Ranchers from across the galaxy exhibit their prized livestock and compete for the coveted "Best in Show."

items.name: Beasts of Burden
items.desc: Our hardiest livestock should do their part in some of our most labor-intensive duties.

items.name: Creature Welfare
items.desc: It is our responsibility to ensure the highest quality of life for the creatures within our care.

items.name: Crack The Whip
items.desc: No matter the species, every organism has a similar response to pain. The trick is learning how to inflict it correctly.

items.name: Exotic Neural Network
items.desc: The minds of the lesser organisms in our care are of sufficient capacity to lend bandwidth in more demanding calculations.

items.name: Self-Preservation Instincts
items.desc: We are as one. Let our instincts entwine in the cold of deep space.

items.name: Biological Overdrive
items.desc: Our lesser creatures can be pushed to their absolute limits with the proper neural receptors installed.

items.name: Behemoth Augmentation: Nanites
items.desc: Nanite infused behemoth shells can regenerate even the worst damage in record time.

items.name: Behemoth Augmentation: Living Metal
items.desc: Layering living metal between chitin layers creates reactive armor with enhanced ablative properties.

items.name: Behemoth Augmentation: Alloys
items.desc: Bolting alloy plates on carapaces is crude but efficient.

items.name: Energy Drain
items.desc: The population is required to have essence harvesting implants installed and inspected on a regular basis. They must be capable of being activated at a moment's notice.

items.name: Sanguine Council
items.desc: Regular fluid tests are mandated for the whole population, through which vital energy is extracted for the benefit of the empire's governing council.

items.name: Nexus Charge
items.desc: Regular fluid tests are mandated for the whole population, through which vital energy is extracted for the benefit of the empire's governing council.

items.name: Convergence of Will
items.desc: With significant mental effort, we can awaken even greater power within our leaders.

items.name: Galactic Dowsing
items.desc: When prospectors add divinatory practices to their conventional geological analyses, they will discover richer veins of resources.

items.name: Galactic Dowsing
items.desc: When prospectors add divinatory practices to their conventional geological analyses, they will discover richer veins of resources.

items.name: Annihilation of Matter
items.desc: With each scrap of dust thrown to the flame, the heat of oblivion burns ever brighter.

items.name: Annihilation of Energy
items.desc: The dance of entropy has been spinning long before we were aware of its magnificence. We only now raise its tempo.

items.name: Dimensional Collapse
items.desc: There are dimensions other than the Shroud entwined with our own. Their power, too, will unravel with time.

items.name: Animatus
items.desc: The §HAnimator of Clay§! sparks new life within our fleets; it is as if they have wills of their own.

items.name: Will of Temperance
